description_preview:
Responsibilities
We are the team that decides how ByteDance's massive fleet of computers gets used — turning hundreds of large-scale clusters and millions of daily workloads (from microservices to big data to the largest AI/LLM training and inference jobs) into a system that is highly efficient, reliable, and increasingly self-managing. At the heart of this is our own intelligent scheduling platform, Godel (open-sourced to the community), together with the systems that manage compute, memory, and power across our global data centers in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: squeeze the most value out of every unit of computing power, at a scale very few places in the world can offer, and increasingly let AI itself help run the infrastructure. As a new grad you'll work alongside senior engineers and global partners on problems whose solutions directly improve the performance and cost of every AI service we run — with real ownership and room to grow fast.
Launch your career where inspiration is infinite. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of 2027 — please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered in the order you apply (limit applies across ByteDance and its affiliates globally). Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; we encourage you to apply early.
We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.
Candidates who pass resume screening will be invited to participate in Our Company's technical online assessment.
Responsibilities
You'll grow from scoped tasks toward end-to-end ownership on problems like:
Make AI infrastructure smarter. Help build the next generation of intelligent, AI-driven scheduling — deciding where and how millions of workloads run so the whole fleet is faster and more efficient.
Push efficiency to the frontier. Work on new ways to get more useful work out of the same hardware — smarter use of compute, memory, and power — directly lowering the cost of running AI at scale.
Operate at global scale, reliably. Help keep a massive, always-on platform stable across regions, and build automation (including AI-agent-assisted tools) that lets the system increasingly diagnose and heal itself.
Turn ideas into impact. Bring fresh thinking from your studies and projects into design discussions, prototype boldly, and see your work run in production for real users.
Why This Role Matters
The AI era runs on compute — and compute is scarce, expensive, and growing faster than the world can build it. How efficiently we use every chip, every server, and every watt is now one of the defining challenges for our company and the entire industry. Our team owns exactly that challenge at ByteDance's global scale: we make the infrastructure behind TikTok and our AI/LLM products faster, smarter, and dramatically more efficient — work that changes the economics of AI itself.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Proficiency in at least one major programming language such as Go, C++, Rust, Python, or Java.
Solid foundation in at least one of: operating systems, distributed systems, computer architecture, networking, or building large-scale software.
Preferred Qualifications
Curiosity about large-scale systems, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML infrastructure — shown through internships, coursework, research, competitions, or personal projects.
Any hands-on exposure to containers or cloud-native systems (e.g., Kubernetes) is a plus, but not required — we value strong fundamentals and a drive to learn.
Bonus: experience contributing to open-source systems projects.

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. About the Team
The Traffic Infrastructure (TI) team leverages unified platform capabilities to manage global edge infrastructure (both self-built and third-party), providing standardized, compliant, scalable, and cost-effective traffic infrastructure capabilities for edge services. Our vision is to build a global edge traffic infrastructure platform and become the long-term cornerstone of ByteDance's global edge business in terms of scale, performance, and cost.
As a New Grad engineer, you will join a team of experienced infrastructure engineers who will mentor you as you grow. You will work on real production systems that serve global edge traffic at massive scale, gaining hands-on exposure to cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and networking from day one.

This role is being recruited by CoffeeSpace on behalf of an early-stage AI startup focused on teaching AI models subjective judgment in creative domains.
We’re looking for innovative applied ML engineers who can lead research to improve AI's understanding of design and aesthetics. If there’s a strong fit, we’ll connect you directly with the team.
Location:
San Francisco, California, United States

$200K–$350K base + 0.25%–1% equity

Full-time

About the company
This company is pioneering the "taste layer" for AI models, focusing on subjective areas like design and creative expression where AI traditionally struggles. The aim is to enhance models' ability to make aesthetic judgments across various creative fields.
Founded in 2024, the team consists of diverse talents from top AI labs and enterprises, poised to transform AI's role in creative processes. With recent seed funding, the company is experiencing rapid growth and aiming for significant impact in the AI landscape.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you will drive full-stack research from experimental design to training and publication. You'll work closely with model labs on cutting-edge projects to establish new benchmarks for subjective taste.

Train and fine-tune models in subjective domains such as design and writing.
Develop sophisticated evaluation methods and benchmarks.

Directly influence the product roadmap and model development.
Collaborate with a network of AI experts and creatives to push the boundaries of AI capabilities.

Experience with LLMs, diffusion models, and creative AI applications.

Entrepreneurial mindset, with a passion for creativity and design.

description_preview:
Energy & Sustainability Engineer
Innovative Refrigeration Systems, Inc.
is the leading provider of industrial refrigeration and process cooling solutions, delivering custom engineered systems utilizing natural refrigerants such as ammonia and CO₂. Through a fully integrated approach encompassing engineering, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, nationwide service, and advanced aftermarket solutions, Innovative supports customers across the food and beverage, cold storage, pharmaceutical, industrial manufacturing, and mission-critical infrastructure markets throughout North America and around the world.
Unlike traditional engineering firms, contractors, or equipment suppliers, Innovative performs engineering, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, service, and ongoing customer support entirely in-house. This integrated model provides employees the opportunity to support projects throughout the complete lifecycle, from concept and design through manufacturing, installation, startup, operation, optimization, modernization, and long-term system support.
Job Role:
The Energy & Sustainability Engineer will assist in evaluating energy performance, analyzing system efficiencies, and recommending improvements in our refrigeration system designs and operations. This role works under the direction of the Energy and Sustainability Department Manager and collaborates with engineering, service, and project teams to ensure optimal energy performance across customer projects.
Key Duties
Develop and implement cutting-edge energy models to assess and improve system efficiency.
Advise customers on energy best practices and collaborate to achieve efficiency goals.
Identify system deficiencies and provide cost-effective, practical solutions.
Perform occasional site assessments, facility walkthroughs, and equipment inspections to better understand system operation and energy performance.
Analyze new and existing systems for energy efficiency opportunities.
Provide energy-efficiency-focused instruction and training for customers.
Host monthly energy efficiency webinars through Microsoft Teams.
Conduct energy usage analysis and identify efficiency opportunities for refrigeration systems.
Support the development and implementation of energy conservation measures.
Review system performance data and develop reports outlining findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with internal teams to integrate energy-efficient practices into new system designs.
Stay current with relevant energy codes, financial incentives, and emerging technologies in the industrial refrigeration sector.
Assist in preparing documentation for utility rebate programs or regulatory compliance.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field preferred.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data.
Effective communication and collaboration skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) and technical software tools.
Must be able to remain in a stationary position (seated or standing) for extended periods.
Occasionally may need to lift or carry items up to 25 pounds (e.g., office supplies, small equipment).
Ability to travel occasionally for customer energy audits or regulatory compliance needs.
Must be able to walk through industrial sites, enter loud mechanical rooms, and work in cold storage areas with appropriate PPE.
Preferences
Interest in energy efficiency, sustainability, or industrial system optimization.
Familiarity with industrial refrigeration systems or HVAC systems.
Previous experience with ENERGY STAR tools, utility benchmarking, or energy reporting.
Familiarity with relevant energy codes, regulatory requirements, or sustainability reporting.
Professional Engineering (PE), Certified Energy Manager (CEM), or similar certification.

This emerging startup focuses on breaking down data silos within research labs. Their platform connects diverse instruments and spreadsheets, enabling scientists to utilize modern AI models for cross-experimental analysis and gain unparalleled visibility into their data.
The company's mission is to empower labs to develop tomorrow's technology by improving data infrastructure, thus reducing the time spent wrangling data and allowing more focus on groundbreaking science.

title: Engineer II
description_preview:
When you join Sallie Mae, you become a champion for all students.
We’re on a mission to power confidence as students begin their unique journey. To help them plan their higher education, successfully finish, and prepare for life after school. To help them Start smart. Learn big.
Students need guidance navigating this important time in their life. They need someone who acknowledges that their education path is unique. They need a partner willing to evolve and not only meet but surpass their expectations. We’re changing. Because students need a better way.
We’re looking for people who are excited to drive this transformation. To break barriers and think of new ways to adapt, help, and create better experiences for students—and for each other.
This is where diverse backgrounds, beliefs, and perspectives matter. It’s where you’re empowered to bring your authentic self to work.
Feeling your best allows you to do your best. Our benefits take care of the whole you—from physical and mental to financial and professional. You’ll get opportunities to further your education and career, support for you and your family (including your pets!), paid time off to volunteer for the things that matter to you, and more.
We’re obsessed with impact and making a real difference. For us, that means putting relationships first, asking “why not?” when tackling challenges, and continuously learning new skills.
Come do more than join something, change something. For students, for future generations, for the future of education.
What You'll Contribute
The Engineer II will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting modern technology solutions that enable critical business capabilities across loan servicing and enterprise operations. This role combines software engineering, business process understanding, and emerging technology expertise to deliver scalable, maintainable, and efficient solutions. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and engineering teams to develop applications, APIs, business rules, and automation capabilities that improve operational effectiveness and customer outcomes.
What You'll Do
Design, develop, test, and support applications and services using Python, SQL, and related technologies.
Partner with business analysts and stakeholders to understand business processes, requirements, and operational objectives.
Develop and maintain API-based integrations using MuleSoft and related integration technologies.
Design and implement business rules and decisioning solutions using modern rules platforms such as Camunda, Drools, or similar technologies.
Build, maintain, and optimize database solutions, queries, and data processing capabilities to support operational and analytical workflows.
Leverage AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to improve development efficiency, operational effectiveness, system intelligence, and business outcomes.
Participate in software design sessions and contribute to architecture decisions that support scalability, maintainability, and long-term business objectives.
Support Agile delivery teams by participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, development, testing, and production support activities.
Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes utilizing Azure DevOps and associated development tools.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues while identifying opportunities for process automation and system improvements.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, solution designs, data flows, and operational support procedures.
Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and operational standards while delivering technology solutions.
The above information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this job; it is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees in this role.
What You Have
Minimum
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
4-7 years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications and integration solutions.
Strong experience developing applications using Python and SQL.
Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs and service-based architectures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand both technical and business requirements.
Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex application and production support issues.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working across the full software development lifecycle from requirements through deployment and support.
Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to emerging technologies and development practices.
Preferred
Experience with MuleSoft development and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience working with rules engines and decisioning platforms such as Camunda, Drools, DMN, or similar technologies.
Experience developing with AWS Cloud and Infrastructure as Code.
Experience applying AI-enabled development tools, machine learning capabilities, or intelligent automation solutions within business processes.
Experience working in financial services, banking, lending, or student loan servicing environments.
Knowledge of event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and modern cloud-native design patterns.
Experience with Snowflake, data engineering, data pipelines, or analytics-focused development.
Familiarity with domain-driven design, business process modeling, and workflow automation concepts.
Experience supporting highly regulated environments and associated compliance requirements.
Feeling Your Best Helps You Do Your Best
Our benefits take care of the whole you—so you can build your work around your life (not the other way around!).

Logistics moves the physical world. It's one of the largest industries on earth — and it still runs on people, spreadsheets, and decades-old systems stitched together by hand. Almost none of it has been touched by modern AI. That's where we need your help.

Well-funded startup

Product Engineer | Forward Deployed Engineer – US Defense AI
San Francisco or Washington DC (on-site) • US Citizens Only • Full-time
US citizenship required – no green cards, no visa sponsorship.
$180k–$240k base + meaningful early equity.
On-site 5 days/week, plus 1–2 weeks/month travel to US military bases.
Most defense software is built by people who've never met the end user. Requirements pass through six layers of contractors, ship eighteen months late, and the operator quietly goes back to Excel.
This seat exists to do the opposite. You fly to the base. You sit with special operations end users, watch how they actually work, and ship the fix – sometimes the same week. The feedback loop isn't a quarterly survey; it's the user, three feet away, telling you it worked.
You'd be joining a small venture-backed AI company on one of the largest AI initiatives in US defense. Every hire is builder headcount, not maintainer headcount.
WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BUILD
End-to-end product slices, not tickets. A typical loop: sit with the end user Monday, sketch the workflow on a whiteboard, ship a working version by Friday, watch them use it, tear out what didn't survive contact. You own every layer of that slice.
Data ingestion at scale – pulling messy, sprawling government and open-source data (documents, portals, semi-structured feeds) into pipelines that are actually reliable: scraping, parsing, dedup, structured extraction. This is where a lot of the hard engineering lives, and it's why the role leans ~70% back-end.
LLM and agent systems in production – tool-calling agents, retrieval over large document sets, structured extraction from unstructured text, prompt pipelines with real evals behind them. Not a chatbot bolted onto a UI; the model work IS the product.
The front-end non-technical end users touch every morning – React/Next.js/TypeScript. It doesn't need to be beautiful; it needs to be obvious. Your users won't file bug reports, they'll just stop using it.
Field-driven iteration – some requirements only surface on-site. You'll gather them yourself, in the room, then come back and build. No PM translating, no BA writing specs. The spec is what you heard.
THE TECHNICAL BAR
2–8 years shipping production full-stack systems end-to-end: Python on the back end, React/Next.js/TypeScript on the front. Your architecture, your commits, your pager.
LLM API work in production – OpenAI/Anthropic-class APIs, agent orchestration, retrieval, and enough eval discipline to know whether your pipeline actually got better. A weekend project doesn't count; something users depended on does.
Data pipeline or web scraping experience at scale is a strong plus – if you've fought pagination, rate limits, malformed PDFs and schema drift and won, say so.
CS fundamentals hold up under a real technical interview. The customer-facing nature of this seat does not lower the engineering bar – it raises the cost of faking it.
You can stand at a whiteboard, explain your system to someone non-technical, and have them lean in, not glaze over. Tested weekly, in rooms where credibility is earned fast.
Actually care about national security. You'll be asked why, and stock answers are easy to spot.
US citizen – non-negotiable. Active Secret/TS clearance is a bonus, not a requirement.

title: Software Engineer, Product
description_preview: Why Numeric? Every business relies on accounting. Yet most software in the space was built in the early 2000s — clunky, slow, and far behind the curve on AI. Today, accountants are facing a growing, unsolved data problem as a consequence of complexity, data, and system fragmentation — and they lack the tools to solve it. The problems are real, hard, and increasingly urgent. But they’re solvable . Enter Numeric — the modern platform for accounting and finance . We're building the platform that realizes the dream of live, rich, trustworthy data and insights for companies to drive decision-making & execution. We tackle foundational challenges required to automate ingest, transformation, matching, projection, and reporting for an end-to-end graph of financial data. Weaving together data, automation, workflows, and AI-first experiences, we’re empowering accounting teams to own the continuous window into companies' finances and activity. We have strong product market fit and a growing base of customers who love our product — including Anthropic, Brex, OpenAI, Plaid, Wealthfront, and many more. We’re backed by top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. The Role Our product teams are responsible for inventing the future of finance and accounting. We work at the whiteboard, we bring fresh eyes to a complex domain, we break down problems to their fundamentals, and we relentlessly seek the right answer to a problem. We have teams in both SF and NYC that are hiring product engineers. There is no single exact profile of skill and background that can succeed, but we rather seek to understand your strengths and assemble teams that work excellently together. You might be a fit if… You care about finding the right abstraction You find learning a new, complex domain to be an exciting challenge You combine a commitment to high quality work with a desire to win and tackle ambitious goals What You Need 5+ years of experience building software Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, or Philosophy High motivation and agency Bonus points for… Experience with building software in complex domains Fintech or accounting-adjacent experience Experience founding a business or building products from scratch Read some of our thoughts on engineering and company-building here. Compensation Range: $175K - $250K
